analyzer.implementation: TAFuzz project-neutral Clang AST weak baseline

metric_definitions.actionable_derived: predicted positive relation AND provided controllability is EXTERNAL/MODELLED; this is a pair-classification diagnostic, not frontier discovery
metric_definitions.candidate_set_size_ratio: within the supplied source×AP universe, predicted MUST/MAY pair count divided by gold MUST/MAY pair count; this is not open source-discovery candidate burden
metric_definitions.edge_kind: headline cross-method edge metric is set membership of (opaque case, given source, given AP, edge kind)
metric_definitions.exact_edge_boundary: raw AST/LLVM/SVF entities are not projected to gold node IDs; exact endpoints are UNPROJECTED_DIAGNOSTIC and never headline
metric_definitions.false_candidate_inflation: within the supplied source×AP universe, predicted-positive/gold-NO pairs divided by gold-positive pairs
metric_definitions.must_detection_recall: gold MUST predicted as MUST or MAY
metric_definitions.must_exact_recall: gold MUST predicted exactly as MUST
metric_definitions.unknown: UNKNOWN is an abstention: it is never counted as NO or as a true negative; on positive gold it is a false negative
